Rae - Marketing: Quick sync 1: want to finalize the 'Developer Sprint' launch: one how-to blog + 30m live lab + 3-email drip. Timing: next Thurs. Can we ship assets by Wed EOD?
Diego - DevRel: I can do the lab repo (demo refapp + README + docker run). Plan a 20min walkthrough + 10min Q&A.
Mina - Growth: Subject lines to test: "Ship a refapp in 30m" vs "See real cost wins from batching". CTA variants: Get the Starter -> vs -> Join the Lab.
Asha - Product: For the bench blurb include model + hardware comparisons, and clear metrics: tokens/sec, p50/p99, tokens per $. We'll provide a one-page reproducible config in the repo.
Leo - Growth Ops: Routing outline: refapp_cta -> self-serve (send repo + onboarding drip). bench_cta -> nurture + tag bench_interest. Add hidden field utm_campaign=dev_sprint. If team_size>50 -> ping SEs.
Rae - Marketing: Social copy idea: ":rocket: Developer Sprint 1: ship a refapp in 30m. Code + live Q&A: https://go.redwood/dev-sprint?utm_campaign=dev_sprint&utm_content=postA"
Diego - DevRel: Repo will include a tiny terraform file optional and a `run_bench.sh` that reproduces main numbers. I'll also add a minimal dataset so folks can run locally.
Mina - Growth: Email cadence: Day0 welcome + repo, Day2 bench highlights + invite, Day5 nudge + replay. We'll A/B subject lines across segments.
Asha - Product: I'll supply the benchmark table and a 1-line Eng quote for social: "Predictable inference is about batching, caching, and choosing the right kernels."
notifier-bot: Reminder: planning check in 24h. RSVP: Rae, Diego, Mina, Leo, Asha.
Rae - Marketing: Owners + deadlines: Diego -> repo + runbook (48h), Mina -> email variants (36h), Leo -> routing rules (24h), Asha -> benchmark artifacts (48h), Rae -> blog + landing (36h). Adding GH tickets now. Thanks :tada:
